name: Age Prompt
description: Prompt an ally with a line out of an age long past and the ally acts with the surety of an old master.

name: Age Mending
description: Mend a mind stripped of years by pouring in the user's own record of the same ages.

name: Age Haze
description: Cast a haze of many overlapping ages over a foe's mind so the foe cannot tell which is now.

name: Age Replay
description: Replay the oldest layer of a place to see who first set foot there.

name: Age Lance
description: Hurl a lance of old memory through the foe's guard of mind.

name: Age Ward
description: Hold a ward of ages kept clean that no rewriting force can cross.

name: Age Seal
description: Seal a stretch of the foe's recall behind an age the foe has forgotten.

name: Age Sweep
description: Sweep a wave of remembered ages across the foes in front of the user.

name: Age Mirror
description: Hold up a mirror of ages and send a probing technique back to its source.

name: Age Erasure
description: Erase a whole age from the foe's memory without leaving a mark on the body.

name: Age Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of ages over a field of foes so none can find their own place in time.

name: Age Memory
description: Cast the whole remembered age outward to strengthen the allies and pierce the foe at a depth set by the user's reserve.

name: Ageflood
description: Let every age the user remembers flood a field at once and break all stance within it up to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Ageless Record
description: Set the record of a whole company beyond any rewriting and hold it so across a field as wide as the ceiling of its tier allows.
